content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the 30-day forecast horizon, especially in the first 5–10 days.
- Model tends to overestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., post-70+ values), often overshooting by 2–5%.
- Model shows persistent downward bias in the middle of the forecast (days 10–20), failing to capture upward momentum.
- Model exhibits mean reversion bias: overcorrects after high values, leading to premature declines.
- Model lags behind true price movements by 2–4 days, particularly in upward trends.
- Model underestimates the magnitude of late-period price increases (last 5–10 days), especially after 70+ levels.
- Model fails to capture volatility clustering — underestimates sharp reversals or sudden spikes in the final 5–7 days.
